title: Lockheed Martin 10-K Diluted Shares
goal: Using SEC EDGAR, open Lockheed Martin Corporation's annual report on Form 10-K for fiscal year 2014. In that filing, find the line item "Weighted average common shares outstanding for diluted computations" and report its value for each of these periods: 2014 and 2013. Report numbers exactly as printed (keep the filing's units; use negative numbers for values shown in parentheses). If you cannot find the filing or the line item, set found=false and do not guess.

found.description: false if the filing or the line item could not be found

units.description: units as printed in the filing, e.g. 'in millions'

filing_url.description: URL of the 10-K document the values came from

output.notes: Lockheed Martin Corporation's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2014, Note 2 – Earnings Per Share, page 69: 'Weighted average common shares outstanding for diluted computations'.
